title: 55 lbs (25 kg) pullovers for 10
summary: Lift clip of NH doing 55 lb (25 kg) dumbbell pullovers for 10 reps over music. The description calls dumbbell pullovers the best lift for stretching the lats and building lat mind-muscle connection, second only to wide-grip pull-ups.

claims.claim: Dumbbell pullovers are the best lift for stretching the lats and building a strong lat mind-muscle connection, second only to wide-grip pull-ups.
